executivo.nota: Leis: as 154 leis ordinárias e complementares com data a partir de 1º/1/2025 cadastradas no SAPL da Câmara, venham de quem vierem (a prefeitura sanciona quase todas). As leis que a própria Câmara promulgou (tipo “Lei Promulgada” no SAPL) ficam fora. Faltam no SAPL 1 dos 142 números de lei do período. Vetos: as mensagens de veto (total ou parcial) que a prefeitura mandou à Câmara a partir de 1º/1/2025, cadastradas no SAPL.
executivo.nota_en: Laws: the 154 ordinary and complementary laws dated from January 1, 2025 on in the City Council's SAPL system, whoever proposed them (the mayor's office signs almost all of them). Laws promulgated by the Council itself (type “Lei Promulgada” in SAPL) are left out. 1 of the 142 law numbers in the period are missing from SAPL. Vetoes: the veto messages (full or partial) the mayor's office sent to the City Council from January 1, 2025 on, as recorded in SAPL.
